description: Defines functions, structures, and enums related to calculating MCS and TBS for PDSCH and PUSCH in 3GPP LTE/5G NR scheduling, including error handling and utility functions.

classes.name: sch_mcs_tbs
classes.description: Container for MCS and TBS results, used to specify modulation and transport block size.

methods.name: compute_dl_mcs_tbs
methods.description: Calculates the MCS and TBS for downlink, ensuring the effective code rate does not exceed 0.95.

methods.name: compute_ul_mcs_tbs
methods.description: Calculates the MCS and TBS for uplink, with error reporting if constraints are not met.

methods.name: compute_ul_tbs
methods.description: Determines the uplink TBS based on MCS and PRBs, assuming valid code rate.

methods.name: compute_ul_tbs_unsafe
methods.description: Calculates uplink TBS without validating code rate.

methods.name: is_pusch_effective_rate_valid
methods.description: Checks if the selected MCS, TBS, and PRBs produce a valid effective code rate and UCI.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts error enum to human-readable string.
